say: Clear messages, voice notes, files and Status.

say: In a busy chat, yes can mean anything. Swipe a message to the right to reply to it. The original appears in a small box above your answer.

panel.heading: Tools for a clear message
items: Swipe right to reply to the exact message
*Stars* make bold; dash and space make a list
Edit a mistake within 15 minutes
Greeting, name, then a clear next step

say: Put a star before and after a word to make it bold. Start a line with a dash and a space to make a list. Keep it light. A whole message in bold feels like shouting.

say: Typed the wrong account number? Press and hold, and tap Edit. You can edit for up to 15 minutes, so nobody pays into the wrong account.

say: Text has no tone of voice, so Ok can sound cold. Start with a greeting, use the person's name, and end with a clear next step.

say: Here is a worked example. Amaka sells small chops in Port Harcourt. A customer asks for 50 packs for a birthday on Saturday.
Amaka swipes right on the order, so her reply sits under it, and types Order confirmed in bold.
Then a dash list. 50 packs at 1,500 naira each. Delivery Saturday at 11am. And please pay 50 percent, that is 37,500 naira, to confirm.
The total, 75,000 naira, is in bold. The customer has no questions, and the deposit arrives within the hour.
Put account numbers, prices, addresses and dates in text. People can copy them, and nobody can search inside a voice note.

panel.heading: Text, voice note or call?
right: Video call to show a product

say: Hold the microphone to record, and slide up to lock for a longer note. Plan first: who you are, what you need, the next step. Try to keep it under a minute.
For a sensitive matter, call. To show a product, use a video call. Zainab the tailor showed her customer a wedding outfit this way, then confirmed the change in text.

say: WhatsApp shrinks photos to save data. For everyday pictures to family, standard quality is fine.

Product photos for customers. Tap HD before sending. Sharp details sell.
Price lists, invoices, CVs and scans. Not compressed, looks professional.

panel.rule: Do not overshare: anyone who views can screenshot.

say: Forwarded many times is a warning sign. Messages about free grants, jobs or bank closures are very often false, and ones that ask for your BVN or bank details are scams.
So ask: who wrote it, is there a date, can I confirm it, could it harm? And never send your card PIN, OTP or card details on WhatsApp.

panel.heading: Check before you share
items: Who wrote it originally?
Is there a date?
Can I confirm it elsewhere?
Could it frighten or harm?
Never send PIN, OTP or card details

say: To remember. Reply to the exact message and bold the key line. Put key numbers in text. Use HD for products and Document for PDFs. Post a few strong status updates, each with one action. And check before you forward.
